name: FDK
summary: FDK Corporation manufactures and sells batteries, rechargeable batteries, battery devices, and electronic components and devices in Japan. It offers alkaline, Ni-MH, lithium, and carbon-zinc batteries; battery system, electric lights, battery materials and rare earth alloys, manufacturing facilities and equipment, switching power supplies, toners, and modules. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
